name: docs-sidenav
description: Persistent left navigation column for product-documentation surfaces. Two-level hierarchy: uppercase category headings as native <details> sections, article links inside. Active page highlighted by border-left accent. Sticky-scrolls independently of article content; hidden below 1024px. Cross-page navigation, distinct from wiki-toc-sidebar (within-article H2/H3 table of contents).
html:
{{category-name}}
  • {{article-title}}

variants.name: hidden-mobile
variants.description: display: none below 1024px — article reachable via breadcrumb. Decided 2026-08-10: no drawer alternative planned; breadcrumb-only is the intended mobile path, not a placeholder.

aria: <nav aria-label='Documentation navigation'>. Active page gets aria-current='page'. Category open/close uses native <details>/<summary> — keyboard-operable (Enter/Space) without JS, correct implicit aria-expanded managed by the browser. Active state is never colour-only: border-left accent + font-weight: 600 alongside the colour change. Below 1024px the rail is display: none (removed from the accessibility tree, not just visually hidden) — article remains reachable via breadcrumb.
